query:
UPDATE propertyfields
               SET name = $1,
                   type = $2::text::property_field_type,
                   attrs = $3::jsonb,
                   targetid = $4,
                   targettype = $5,
                   protected = $6,
                   permissionfield = $7::text::permission_level,
                   permissionvalues = $8::text::permission_level,
                   permissionoptions = $9::text::permission_level,
                   linkedfieldid = $10,
                   updateat = $11,
                   deleteat = $12,
                   updatedby = $13
             WHERE id = $14
               AND ($15::text = '' OR groupid = $15)
               AND updateat = $16
